items.docs: Retrieve rows from a POSLavu data table. Provide the `dataname`, `key`, and `token` credentials from the API tab of the POSLavu Control Panel, select the `table`, and optionally filter with `column`/`value` (exact match) or `column`/`value_min`/`value_max` (range), and paginate with `limit` (offset,count). Responses are returned as XML `<row>` elements.
